dataset.name: WTC 1 V8U OpenRadioss facade-impact qualification submodel
dataset.scope: Qualify a moving rigid-sphere contact against a small shell facade surrogate, with WTC-adjacent steel data, explicit failure-strain sensitivity, mesh convergence, energy audit, and 1-versus-4-thread repeatability. This is not a JT9D model, a full exterior-wall panel, a fuel-wing calculation, a global WTC impact, a fire calculation, an initiation calculation, or a collapse calculation.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: Directly read from a cited source file or solver output.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A value reported by a NIST or Altair numerical model; it is not an observation of the real event.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: A statement from the read-only archive; none is used as a physical input in V8U.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: A declared simplification or parameter without an exact source for the modeled location.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from the declared inputs and solver outputs.
evidence_policy.unknown: A missing value or physical capability not qualified by V8U.

geometry.model_type: three closed square shell columns joined by a continuous one-story spandrel strip
geometry.boundary_condition: all translational and rotational degrees of freedom fixed at top and bottom column-edge nodes
geometry.weld_representation: shared shell nodes at column-spandrel boundaries; no explicit weld, bolt, splice plate, floor slab, or truss-seat model
limitations: The exact plate schedule for panel 124 at floor 96 is not present in the frozen local source set.
The 5/16 in flange and 3/8 in spandrel values are nearby/recovered representative values, not a recovered panel-124 schedule.
The closed-square shell construction is a qualification surrogate and is not an exact reconstruction of the fabricated perimeter-column cross-section.

material.engineering_strain_at_uts_status: approximate digitization/bounding choice from NIST Figure A-8; not tabulated
material.rate_formulation: Johnson-Cook logarithmic multiplier in LAW2; plastic strain-rate flag
material.failure_status: mesh-dependent hypothesis range; 0.20 is shown in the NIST component example but is not a measured panel-124 fracture law

projectile.mass_origin: one half of 20,100 lb engines-with-cowlings ledger
projectile.impact_location: centered on the middle column and middle of the spandrel strip
limitations: Rigid sphere rather than a deformable JT9D engine/cowling assembly.
Diameter is a declared 1.0 m contact surrogate, not a sourced engine-core diameter.
No rotating machinery, breakup, wing, fuel, fuselage, pitch, yaw, or oblique trajectory.

predeclared_gates.scope_warning: Passing V8U qualifies only this rigid-sphere/shell-surrogate numerical chain. It does not validate NIST's global damage state, an actual aircraft breakup, a fire-to-collapse chain, or any demolition hypothesis.
